items.title: hermes-agent-helm (Deployment & Infra)
items.content: A community-maintained Helm chart for running Hermes Agent on Kubernetes, with configuration for Hermes-supported LLM providers and optional Discord or Telegram gateway integrations. It also supports grouping multiple instances into a Hermes Team and enabling the web dashboard with ingress and sign-in options.
